DeterminationBasis: Existing T13 controls preserve failures and mandatory-requirement deviations in governed evidence or conformance records, but no existing T13 control requires a material deviation specifically to be included in the conformance evidence package. Recording or preserving a deviation somewhere in governed evidence is not equivalent to the package-inclusion SHALL in DEV-008. A dedicated conformance-evidence-package inclusion control is therefore required.

T14-001 directly establishes lifecycle integrity for a frozen normative or evidentiary artifact, requires the artifact to retain identical identity and content through normal use, and fails if normal processing materially mutates the frozen artifact. This directly tests the prohibition on silently editing a frozen normative artifact.
